title: 30004630: refute unchanged unregularized strong-L2 growth for the critical wave
body:
The actual capped energy-critical quintic-wave problem on the 3D unit ball has a unique global zero optimizer with ordinary critical cone {0}. The source strict condition is vacuous, while feasible controls converging in Linfinity have gap o(the squared control-L2 norm), defeating both source localizations after beta2 is removed. For every fixed finite nonnegative velocity weight, every global optimizer under positive radial terminal-target perturbations fails the stated Lipschitz L2 estimate. Local L1 quadratic growth and weaker fixed-basepoint upper bounds survive. This answers the unchanged implication, without claiming a complete unregularized replacement theory or a sharp exponent.
